name: Sonnet small/mid-cap growth
strategy: Equal-weight basket of high-growth small/mid-cap companies across software, fintech, biotech, industrials and consumer, selected for durable secular tailwinds (AI adoption, automation, digital payments, healthcare innovation) and reasonable momentum heading into 2026, aiming to outpace the large-cap-dominated S&P 500 over a 6-month horizon.

orders.reason: Growth deceleration and competitive pressure from Asana/ClickUp have broken the durable-growth thesis; cut the loss.
Energy-drink category growth stalling and distribution/inventory issues have eroded the secular growth story.
Pre-revenue satellite buildout carries binary execution risk disproportionate to position sizing; trim speculative exposure.
Direct-to-consumer telehealth/GLP-1 platform with durable subscription growth and expanding margins in consumer health.
Samsara's industrial IoT/fleet-telematics platform has a long secular runway in physical-operations digitization.
Klaviyo's marketing-automation platform is taking share in SMB/e-commerce software with strong net-revenue retention.

outlook: Expect continued dispersion in H2 with AI-infra leadership broadening into software/consumer beneficiaries; small/mid growth should re-rate higher as rate-cut expectations firm, though volatility around growth-scare episodes persists.
